name: Christofer Vilander
title: IT Product Manager
about: I have 15+ years of experience in the IT and E-Commerce industry, spanning both strategic and operational roles. Currently, I am a Product Area Manager at Lyko, where I lead teams developing our E-Commerce, App, POS, and AI initiatives. I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Media & Communication Studies, complemented by courses in Web Development and C#. I enjoy working at the intersection of business and IT, and my goal is to continuously learn and develop in both areas.
